answer.reason: In Table 1 of the EIA Idaho Electricity Profile, the 13,475,312 MWh figure is Idaho's total net generation (the 'Total' line), not the Electric utilities line. The Electric utilities row lists 6,560,126 MWh, and the remaining ~6,915,186 MWh comes from independent power producers/CHP (6,560,126 + 6,915,186 = 13,475,312). The supplied draft answer B appears to have confused the state total with the Electric utilities producer type. Since no table excerpt was supplied in the source text, this conclusion relies on prior knowledge of the EIA table structure and values.
